# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Category Matrix v1

## Core categories

### Mechanical & Engine
Engine service, mechanical systems, diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, and specialist mechanical work.

### Electrical & Electronics
Electrical systems, batteries, chargers, navigation electronics, communications, and related specialist work.

### Hull, Fiberglass & Structural
Hull repairs, fiberglass, structural work, gelcoat, and specialist surface repairs.

### Marine Plumbing & Pumps
Fresh water, sanitation, bilge, pumps, hoses, valves, and related systems.

### Air Conditioning & Refrigeration
Marine HVAC, refrigeration, cooling systems, and specialist servicing.

### Cleaning & Detailing
Interior/exterior cleaning, detailing, teak care, polishing, and presentation services.

### Canvas, Upholstery & Covers
Canvas, covers, upholstery, cushions, and protective materials.

### Rigging & Deck Hardware
Rigging, lines, winches, deck hardware, anchors, and related specialist work where applicable.

### Fuel & Fluid Services
Fuel delivery, fuel-related services, fluid changes, and specialist handling where appropriate.

### Marina & Yard Services
Haul-outs, lifts, storage, dock services, yard coordination, and marina relationships.

### Diving & Underwater Services
Hull inspection, underwater cleaning, propeller/anode checks, and related services.

### Storm & Emergency Response
Emergency access, storm preparation, post-storm response, damage mitigation, and urgent specialist support.

## Category requirements

Each active category should have:

- At least one qualified vendor where practical.
- A preferred vendor when performance history supports it.
- A backup vendor for higher-risk or time-sensitive categories where practical.
- Defined geographic/service limitations.
